name: Cassia gum
aliases: E427, cassia gum, cassia seed gum, cassia galactomannan, Cassia tora gum, Cassia obtusifolia gum, goma cassia
what_is: A purified galactomannan-rich material from the endosperm of Cassia tora and Cassia obtusifolia seeds, used as a thickener, stabiliser and gelling agent.
why_botia: Cassia gum thickens by retaining water, and part of it is fermented in the large intestine. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical intake limit, but it keeps the specifications tentative because a sufficiently reliable method to control residual anthraquinones is still lacking. These compounds can have a laxative effect, and the label does not indicate how much is present.
can_1: Identify E427 or cassia gum when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Verify from the label whether a batch meets regulatory purity specifications.
cannot_2: Determine the concentration or residual impurity profile of the additive in the finished food.

sources.label: EU specifications for authorised food additives — Regulation (EU) No 231/2012
